alarms.condition: Motor overload contact MOL-1001 opens (X13 is OFF)
alarms.name: Motor Overload Alarm

alarms.action: Conveyor stops and jam alarm (M190) is raised until reset by PB-0002 (X1)
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs
alarms.name: Conveyor Jam Alarm

conflicts.narrative_says: If entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs, conveyor stops and jam alarm is raised
conflicts.program_says: Timer T10 and detection logic for entry photo-eye PE-1002 are missing from the ST10 program entirely

conflicts.narrative_says: A motor overload or the E-stop chain stops the conveyor immediately (stopping when E-stop is lost)
conflicts.program_says: R3 uses ORI X0 to set M199, which turns on fault flag M199 when E-stop is healthy (X0 ON) instead of when E-stop is tripped (X0 OFF)

interlocks.cause: Motor overload MOL-1001 (X13 lost) or E-stop chain lost (X0 lost)

interlocks.effect: Reports pallet in position (M100) to ST20

interlocks.cause: Line controller release request RQ-1005 (X14) rising edge
interlocks.effect: Energises stopper solenoid XY-1004 (Y11) for 2.0 s

steps.entry: Auto mode SS-0003 (X2) active, no ST10 fault present, and E-stop healthy
steps.exit: Auto mode lost, ST10 fault occurs (motor overload or jam), or E-stop chain lost
steps.name: Conveyor Running

steps.entry: Rising edge of line controller release request RQ-1005 (X14)
steps.exit: Stopper release timer T11 reaches 2.0 s preset
steps.name: Stopper Release
